messages.text:
Some people gather stamps. I build websites for Roofing companies who have no idea I exist.
This week it was franklin roofing's turn. Website is finished and sitting on a server.
Want to see how it looks? Just give me a quick 'yes' and I'll send you the link.
PS: If you think it's garbage, tell me it's garbage. That's genuinely useful to me. If you like it we can talk.

Andrew Juran
Co-Founder @ Mindaptive.ai
Got a web site what the problem what makes your any different

Here is your new website -> [link: https://franklin-roofing.vercel.app] https://franklin-roofing.vercel.app
Fair question. Three things yours doesn't do:
Modern and elegant design which improves credibility
An AI agent on the site that answers roofing questions at 11pm while you're up a ladder all day, not a contact form nobody checks.
Better SEO. Real pages for Hanley, Longton, Burslem, Tunstall and Newcastle, each one Google can actually rank, instead of "Stoke-on-Trent" mentioned once.
A roof checker and quote tool that gets the details (what's wrong, how urgent, what kind of property) before they ever call you.

Connects to whatever you use to track jobs, so it's not one more inbox to check. this is just a first version of the website. I usually do 3 rounds of revisions at least.
P.S: Sorry for not getting this to you yesterday. I was locked into a project all day and didn't get a chance to hit send.

Andrew

messages.text: What’s the cost?

That site is yours for $850, one time. That's the whole thing.
How it works:
You send me what you want to change or add (photos, branding, etc..), and anything you want worded differently. That's the only thing I need from you. No calls, no forms, no chasing.
I finish it and send it back. Three rounds of changes. Anything you don't like, I will fix it.
When you approve it, it's live in 5 days. Your current site stays up, untouched, until that moment.
You pay  $850 on launch day, not before. If we go through the changes and you still don't want it, you don't need to pay me.
After launch:
Standalone — $0/month. I set up this site on your current hosting service and you manage it yourself.
Website Care — $49/month. Hosting (my servers), security, and small changes whenever you need them.

If you would like to do this over the phone you can give me your number and I'll give you a call.

Ciao Roberto,

Mi fa piacere che tu abbia "sgamato" subito l'AI agent. Hai occhio! Essendo del settore, apprezzerai la trasparenza tecnica.

Ecco le risposte sul nostro framework:

1. Tech Stack & Orchestrazione: A differenza di molte agenzie che usano tool standard (come Clay), noi abbiamo costruito un'orchestrazione proprietaria. Usiamo agenti AI interni sviluppati da noi per gestire l'intero flusso di ricerca e scrittura.

2. Data Collection & Scraping: Per la base dati utilizziamo database solidi come Apollo, ma il vero valore è nel "layer" successivo: i nostri agenti navigano in tempo reale per arricchire i dati con informazioni contestuali che i database statici non hanno.

3. Modelli AI: Siamo "model agnostic". Non ci leghiamo a un solo provider. I nostri agenti utilizzano dinamicamente il modello migliore per il task specifico—che sia ChatGPT, Gemini o Claude—in base a quale performa meglio per il reasoning o il copywriting in quel momento.

4. Costi Operativi (Unit Economics): Il costo per generare 1.000 contatti varia, ma la cosa fondamentale è questa: tu non te ne devi preoccupare.Lavorando a Performance (Pay-per-Lead), noi ci assumiamo interamente il rischio operativo e i costi delle API/modelli. Tu non paghi per la lista o per lo scraping, ma solo per le risposte positive che ti portiamo.

Se ti va di vedere come girano i nostri agenti nel backend, possiamo fare una call veloce.

A presto,
Mia

Stavo pensando di più alla missione di JER-3. Non siete una società di consulenza tradizionale; siete un ponte tra il mondo accademico e quello aziendale, portando innovazione a startup e PMI. La sfida per un'organizzazione dinamica come la vostra è trovare un flusso costante di nuovi clienti che hanno bisogno del vostro supporto strategico, senza distogliere i vostri membri dal loro lavoro di consulenza e dai loro studi.

È qui che entriamo in gioco noi. Il nostro servizio è progettato per essere il vostro motore di acquisizione clienti. Invece di inviare un'email generica, il nostro agente AI identifica un founder che ha appena annunciato un nuovo round di finanziamento su LinkedIn (un segnale chiave che ha bisogno di una strategia di go-to-market), ricerca il suo business e crea un messaggio iper-personalizzato che porta a una riunione prenotata direttamente sul vostro calendario.

Quello che ottenete è un canale diretto con le aziende che hanno bisogno della vostra competenza consulenziale, permettendo al vostro team di concentrarsi solo sulla fornitura di valore.

E dato che il nostro modello è pay-per-meeting, come abbiamo discusso, investite solo in conversazioni qualificate.
Fammi sapere se questo ti sembra un modo più efficace per far crescere la pipeline di JER-3.

A presto,
Andrew

Hi Andrew, I just had a few questions about the website:1. What platform/framework was the website built with? (Next.js, React, WordPress, Webflow, etc.)2. Do I receive full ownership of the source code?3. Can I edit the website myself without paying you for every content change?4. Can I change pages, text, images, service areas, blog posts, SEO titles and meta descriptions myself?5. Does the website include an XML sitemap and robots.txt?6. Does every service and location page have its own unique SEO title, meta description, H1 and content?7. Are there any monthly hosting, software, licensing or maintenance fees required to keep the website running?8. Who owns the domain, website code, images, content and hosting account?

Ed Kamhawy
Project manager
United Heating and Cooling
Mobile : 919-606-0112

Hi Ed,

Everything you asked for is a yes. The one thing that decides a few of the answers is whether you want to run the site or whether you want me to run it, so let me lay that out first.

Option A. It is all yours.
One-off fee, $950. I build it, do the revisions, change everything you want on the page including adding pages and removing them. Then hand over the full source code, put everything in your name, and help you get the hosting set up.
After that you own the lot and you pay me nothing, monthly or otherwise. You or your team make the changes.

Option B. I run it for you.
$950 to build, then $45 a month. I host it, I make every change you ask for, I fix anything that breaks, I handle backups, SSL and security.
You email me what you want changed and it is done the same day. You still own the domain, the content and the code, and you can take it and leave whenever you want. This is the no-thinking-about-it option.

Now your questions:
Built in React on TanStack Start, same family as Next.js. The pages are rendered on the server, so Google gets the finished page instantly and it loads faster than WordPress. No plugins to break.
Yes. Under Option A it is handed straight over. Under Option B it is still yours and I hand it over any time you ask.
and 4. Under Option A, yes, everything: pages, text, images, service areas, blog, SEO titles and meta descriptions. One question there, do you want a visual editor where you click and save, or will your team edit the code directly? Both work, I just need to know which to build. Under Option B you do not edit anything, you just tell me and I do it, at no extra charge.
Yes, both included.
Yes. Every service and every town gets its own page with its own title, meta description, H1 and content. One page listing all your towns ranks for none of them. A page per town is what shows up for "AC repair Cary".
No licences, no plugin fees, no maintenance fees, ever. Under Option A hosting is the only cost and it is small, paid by you directly. Under Option B the $45 covers it all.
You do, either way. Domain, code, images, content, hosting account, all in your name. Nothing is registered under me. If you decide to cancel the monthly parthership you keep everything.

Let me know if that makes sense.

Thanks,
Andrew

- **Target patients:** Residents across Lithuania, from preventative care to complex smile restoration and orthodontic treatment
- **Team size:** ~4,000 medical professionals including dentists, specialists, university professors
- **Decision-maker signals:** Julija is "Odontologijos prekės ženklų vadovė" (Odontology Brand Manager) — manages brand positioning/strategy for their dental/ortho divisions; likely input on patient experience improvements, marketing decisions
- **Review signal:** Large, established network with strong reputation; less likely to have review gaps, but patient acquisition/retention into treatment plans is likely a key operational focus
- **Call volume indicators:** Multi-location clinic network with high patient inquiry volume; phone/WhatsApp/website contact channels likely active across all locations; after-hours/overflow call handling probable pain point
